name: flowwave
description: Privacy-first personal energy and focus rhythm application.

scripts.generate: npm run build -w @flowwave/core && npm run prisma:generate -w @flowwave/api
scripts.lint: npm run generate && eslint . && npm run lint -w @flowwave/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run generate && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.contracts:generate: npm run openapi:generate -w @flowwave/api && npm run generate -w @flowwave/contracts
scripts.contracts:check: npm run contracts:generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/contracts
scripts.db:seed: npm run generate && npm run db:seed -w @flowwave/api
